purpose: Additional independent qualification of the frozen r3 installed wheel's schema2-to-schema3 migration; no new product behavior or source edits
required_interpreter: Isolated Python 3.12 virtual environment invoked with -I
source_import_policy: No repository source, test, eval or fixture imports. Validate installed module locations and every wheel package file byte-for-byte before creating the database.
database_policy: Create and stop an owned disposable PostgreSQL 18.6 server on a private Unix socket. No supplied database URL or existing application database is accepted.
legacy_schema_setup: Read installed schema.sql and run installed upgrade_1_to_2 with the offline migration identity; grant the separate non-owner runtime role.
legacy_facts: Two organizations with separate identically named legacy actors
Real HostedRuntime complete run with logical unknown-tool rejection, two verified model results, used usage, budget, checkpoint, evidence chain, receipts and physical call facts
Real HostedRuntime unknown run with nonzero reserved usage and unit reservations, full admitted physical input and evidence
Legacy governance run with independent exact approval, send, receipt, settlement and outbox events
snapshot_policy: Enumerate every schema2 table except schema_version. All must be nonempty. For every row, persist PostgreSQL row_to_json(row)::text and compare the complete UTF-8 snapshot bytes and SHA-256, not selected columns.
failure_injection: Precreate workspaces to fail migration after accounts/org_members DDL; assert schema2 version, version constraint, absent rolled-back new tables, every legacy row and inspect/trace results are unchanged.
successful_upgrade: Explicit upgrade_2_to_3(writers_stopped=True), then verify schema3, exact equality of all legacy table rows, no automatic accounts or run_bindings, unchanged inventory and unknown reservation. Explicitly refresh grant_runtime using the offline migration identity before reading historical state with the schema3-aware 0.13 installed runtime.
history_compatibility: Use the original trusted HostedRuntime to inspect and restore/verify full trace chains before and after migration. Compare complete view JSON and trace bytes and prove no read changes any legacy fact.
evidence_binding: all installed package bytes match wheel
scope_limit: This checks migration and historical read compatibility with deterministic synthetic state. It does not qualify a production database, real customer data, deployment availability, real model billing, or concurrent online upgrade. API writers and workers are stopped during the upgrade.
